rows.description: A composable, cross-platform MVVM framework for .NET inspired by functional reactive programming. It moves mutable state out of the user interface, keeps each feature's logic in one readable place, and makes applications easier to test. Supports WPF, WinForms, WinUI, .NET MAUI, Avalonia, Uno Platform, Blazor and Android.
